prompt: My cousin explained that he (can / to change) a flat tyre quickly.
explanation_ru: После глагола речи в прошедшем времени (explained) модальный глагол can переходит в could.

prompt: Kieran complained that he (cannot / to lift) the heavy suitcase upstairs.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи после complained отрицательная форма cannot сдвигается в could not (couldn't).

prompt: Our guide warned us that the forest trail (may / to turn) muddy.
explanation_ru: Для выражения вероятности в косвенной речи после прошедшего времени (warned) may меняется на might.

prompt: Before class began, the teacher told us that everyone (must / to wear) an apron.
explanation_ru: Когда must выражает обязанность, в косвенной речи после глагола в прошедшем времени он обычно переходит в had to.

prompt: Priya whispered that she (could / to hear) a strange noise outside.
explanation_ru: Модальный глагол could не имеет более «прошлой» формы и в косвенной речи остаётся без изменений.

prompt: Grandad insisted that we (should / to pack) warm sandwiches for the trip.
explanation_ru: Глагол should в косвенной речи не сдвигается и сохраняет свою форму.

prompt: Our dog nearly escaped twice, so Rosa reminded her brother that he (should / not / to forget) the back gate.
explanation_ru: Отрицательная форма should not (shouldn't) в косвенной речи остаётся без изменений.

prompt: Waiting for a delayed bus, Dev remarked that if he (to live) closer to the centre, he (would / to walk) to work.
explanation_ru: Условные предложения второго типа (Past Simple + would) при передаче в косвенную речь не меняют время.

prompt: The café manager warned us that staff (must / not / to share) the private Wi-Fi password with customers.
explanation_ru: При передаче запрета must not (mustn't) не меняется на didn't have to, потому что это исказило бы смысл.

prompt: After missing the early coach to Leeds, Sofia admitted that if she (to set) two alarms, she (would / to catch) it on time.
explanation_ru: Условные предложения третьего типа (Past Perfect + would have + V3) в косвенной речи сохраняются без изменений.

prompt: Looking at the hotel bill, Omar sighed that if he (to book) the room a month earlier, he wouldn't have paid nearly so much.
explanation_ru: В третьем типе условных предложений (сожаление о прошлом) в части с if используется Past Perfect и не меняется в косвенной речи.

prompt: A heavy shelf fell off our kitchen wall. My brother promised that he (can / to repair) it after dinner. He also told me he (will / to buy) stronger screws from the corner shop. In the end, the shelf looked as good as new.
explanation_ru: После promised и told в прошедшем времени модальный глагол can переходит в could, а will — в would.

prompt: My bike chain broke on the way to college. The mechanic said a small shop across town (may / to sell) the right part. However, he added that if it was out of stock, he (will / to order) one for me. Luckily, the shopkeeper had the exact piece.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи после said и added глагол may (вероятность) сдвигается в might, а will — в would.

prompt: Traffic moved slowly along the main road all week. Watching cyclists pass us, Lukas remarked that if he (to own) a bike, he would use the river path instead. His colleague agreed and mentioned that she (might / to try) cycling in spring. Neither of them enjoyed sitting in queues.
explanation_ru: Условное предложение второго типа сохраняет Past Simple (owned), а модальный глагол might в косвенной речи не изменяется.

prompt: An unsigned birthday card arrived at reception. Marta looked at the envelope and announced that she (could / to recognise) the neat handwriting immediately. She explained that she (to receive) three postcards in that exact style before. Moments later, our former manager phoned to wish us well.
explanation_ru: Глагол could в косвенной речи остаётся прежним, а действие, случившееся ранее, передаётся через Past Perfect (had received).

prompt: Planning our summer trip to Milan turned out harder than expected. Tariq joked that if he (to speak) Italian properly, he would phone the small guesthouse directly instead of using a slow website. His sister replied that the host (might / to answer) an email in English anyway. She also wondered whether the host (to confirm) our dates yet.
explanation_ru: Во втором типе условных предложений остаётся spoke, might не сдвигается, а Present Perfect в вопросе с yet переходит в Past Perfect.

prompt: Our new electric kettle stopped boiling water after only three days. Viktor admitted that if he (to save) the paper receipt, he would have returned it for a refund. His flatmate pointed out that Viktor (to pay) by card, so the bank app proved the purchase. He reminded Viktor (to download) the statement, and two afternoons later they collected a replacement.
explanation_ru: В третьем условном сохраняется had saved, предшествующее прошлое действие передаётся через had paid, а после remind ставится to-инфинитив.

prompt: Rafael told his neighbour that he ___ the borrowed ladder before Sunday.
explanation_ru: Обязанность must после глагола в прошедшем времени (told) переходит в had to; оставлять must в таком контексте — частая ошибка.

prompt: As the meeting room was full, Elena told the new intern that he ___ her quiet desk near the window.
explanation_ru: Разрешение may/can в косвенной речи переходит в could; вариант had to меняет смысл на обязанность, а can/will не учитывают сдвиг времени.

prompt: Seeing warm light behind the curtains, Ines remarked that her parents ___ home from the theatre.
explanation_ru: Когда must выражает логическое предположение («должно быть»), он не меняется на had to, иначе фраза приобретает значение обязанности.

prompt: Watching his friends climb onto the sailing boat, Hassan admitted that if he ___ properly, he would gladly join them on the lake.
explanation_ru: Во втором типе условных предложений could в придаточном с if не меняется; ставить can или would после if — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Before turning off the laptop, Kenji reminded me that I should save a backup copy of the report.
answer: Before turning off the laptop, Kenji reminded me that I should save a backup copy of the report.
accepted_answers: Before turning off the laptop, Kenji reminded me that I should save a backup copy of the report.
explanation_ru: Предложение верно: модальный глагол should не меняется при переходе в косвенную речь.

prompt: The HR officer emailed everyone last Friday to say that all staff must update their phone numbers before the new system launched.
answer: The HR officer emailed everyone last Friday to say that all staff had to update their phone numbers before the new system launched.
accepted_answers: The HR officer emailed everyone last Friday to say that all staff had to update their phone numbers before the new system launched.
explanation_ru: Ошибка — сохранение must для обязанности в завершённой прошлой ситуации: после прошедшего времени нужно использовать had to.

prompt: Complaining about the rising train fares, Zofia told her manager that if she worked from home twice a week, she will save hours of travel.
answer: Complaining about the rising train fares, Zofia told her manager that if she worked from home twice a week, she would save hours of travel.
accepted_answers: Complaining about the rising train fares, Zofia told her manager that if she worked from home twice a week, she would save hours of travel.
Complaining about the rising train fares, Zofia told her manager that if she worked from home twice a week, she'd save hours of travel.
explanation_ru: Ошибка — замена would на will в условном предложении второго типа; в косвенной речи форма would save сохраняется.

prompt: With a mild headache, Mei told her husband: “If I felt better, I would cook pasta tonight.” Which sentence reports her words correctly the next day?
options: Mei told her husband that if she felt better, she would cook pasta that night.
Mei told her husband that if she feels better, she would cook pasta that night.
Mei told her husband that if she would feel better, she cooked pasta that night.
Mei told her husband that if she felt better, she will cook pasta tonight.
explanation_ru: Второй тип условных предложений (felt + would cook) сохраняется в косвенной речи, а tonight меняется на that night.

prompt: Uncertain about the knee exercise plan, Owen told his coach: “I should ask another specialist before running a marathon.” Which report is accurate?
options: Owen told his coach that he had to ask another specialist before running a marathon.
Owen told his coach that he must ask another specialist before running a marathon.
Owen told his coach that he shall ask another specialist before running a marathon.
Owen told his coach that he should ask another specialist before running a marathon.
explanation_ru: Модальный глагол should в косвенной речи не меняется; замена на had to или must превращает совет в жёсткую обязанность.

prompt: Niamh said: “If I had a reliable car, I would drive down to the coast.” → Niamh explained that …
answer: Niamh explained that if she had a reliable car, she would drive down to the coast.
accepted_answers: Niamh explained that if she had a reliable car, she would drive down to the coast.
Niamh explained that if she had a reliable car, she'd drive down to the coast.
explanation_ru: В условном предложении второго типа глаголы had и would drive не сдвигаются, меняется только местоимение I на she.
